blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Police arrested two Korean nationals in General Trias City, Cavite, on Tuesday pursuant to separate Red Notices issued by the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) in connection with criminal cases in their home country. The two suspects, aged 25 and 29, were both residents of a subdivision in the city. The report did not specify the suspects’ genders.
